what: A CSS 3D box with four photos on its sides (40vw wide, 26vw high, 40vw deep, 1200px perspective) holds the section pinned while scrolling: it grows from 0 to 1x (1), turns once around the Y axis (10, constant speed) with each face’s description typing in, then tips 89.9° on the X axis so the bottom face (a dark screen) faces front (1) and scales 4x (.5) to cover the screen — becoming the dark background of the next section

options.[data-fx-part=face]: Four sides (children, in order front → left → back → right)
options.[data-fx-part=floor]: Floor plane (child, optional) — the plane that covers the screen after the fall
options.[data-fx-part=caption]: Per-face caption slot (child, optional) — replaced with the face element’s data-caption text
